items.summary: Recommendation: retain financial containment and reject the proposed shared CTA-component prototype this cycle. AI usage cost is $997.51762695 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-30 across 5,522 calls, including 234 errors and 5 transient errors. Amazon evidence covers only 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission; site-attributed income is $0 because the commission is under an unattributed aggregate provider row. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, and cost-to-learn are not calculable because infrastructure, registrar, labor, and other direct costs are absent, and the revenue and AI-cost periods are not aligned. Keep the allthingsmasonic.com CTA request capacity-gated; measure registered affiliate clicks against the 61-click 2026-09-21 baseline only. Do not claim revenue, margin, ROI, forecast, or causal lift.
